answer_1.quote: In Phase 1, participants were asked to write a 200-250 word article within 45 minutes... we asked our participants to work on one of the two types of writing tasks: • Argumentative essay writing... • Creative story writing...
datasets: Phase 1 writing samples collected on Prolific
answer_1.outputs: Human‑written argumentative essays and creative stories (200‑250 words) produced with varying levels of AI assistance

answer_4.quote: Participants were each asked to review a random set of six articles... they first evaluated its overall quality on a scale from 1 to 5 stars... they then provided their detailed evaluation of this article on five specific aspects, including the article's (a) grammar and vocabulary, (b) organization, (c) originality, (d) creativity, and (e) emotional authenticity.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to rate overall quality, willingness to shortlist for a bonus, and to assess five detailed aspects (grammar & vocabulary, organization, originality, creativity, emotional authenticity).
